summary: Contestants demonstrate advanced word processing skills by creating, editing, and formatting a variety of business documents with accuracy. The event includes an on-site application test and a MOS Word 365 Expert certification exam at NLC. Any secondary or postsecondary student may enter, but only one Word Processing event per year.
time_limits: No more than ten (10) minutes orientation
No more than ninety (90) minutes testing time
No more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
No more than fifty (50) minutes for certification test
submission_requirements: All contestant-produced jobs completed on-site are uploaded electronically and are not printed at the national level
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
competencies: Create, format, and manage diverse business documents using word processing tools and features such as styles, templates, headers/footers, section breaks, mail merge and multi-column layouts
Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of word processing software functions, including automation features, utilizing digital reference and collaborative editing tools
Integrate and format data using tables, charts, and infographics
Insert visual elements applying accessibility standards and advanced formatting tools
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed

Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
Reference materials are not allowed for certification testing
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this application event.
Contestants may compete in only one of the following events each year: Fundamental Word Processing, Intermediate Word Processing, or Advanced Word Processing.
